senses.definition: n.f. assembly (?as confined, held in);—abs. עֲצָרָה Is 1:13 + 2 times; עֲצֶ֫רֶת Dt 16:8 + 3 times, עֲצָ֑רֶת 2 Ch 7:9; cstr. עֲצֶ֫רֶת Je 9:1; pl. sf. עַצְרֹתֵיכֶם Am 5:21;—

sacred assembly, rejected by י׳, Is 1:13 and (at Bethel, etc.) Am 5:21; for Baal 2 K 10:20; Dt 16:8 (last day of Maṣṣoth), Lv 23:36 (P), Nu 29:35 (P), Ne 8:18 (all of day after feast of booths), cf. 2 Ch 7:9 [NH of feast of weeks, 𝔗 עֲצַרְתָּא JosAnt. iii. 10, 6 Ἀσάρτα]; occasional, Jo 1:14; 2:15.
assemblage, company (in gen.), ע׳ בֹּגְדִים Je 9:1 an assemblage of deceivers (Gr עֲדַת; Che חֶבְרַת).
